title: A flashlight message takes a day to reach Voyager 1
description:
Astronomers worked out that light needs one day to reach Voyager 1, which is about 26 billion km away. At one light-day per 50 years, one light-year is about 18,250 years away.
NASA picture: JPL, PIA26353. An artist’s concept of a Voyager probe, not a photo.
Every day’s picture: https://cosmos.rimilab.com/
Today’s APOD photo is by Apostolos Kyriazis: https://science.nasa.gov/image-article/apod-2026-november-20-v-g-r/. To use it, please ask the owner.
